title: Correct two latched patch connections while preserving a third
instruction: Correct the crossed blue and orange patch leads so each occupies its matching port. Release each catch before withdrawing the plug, and leave each catch engaged afterward. Keep the green link connected throughout.
context: Correcting an existing mispatch while preserving a working link tests maintenance rework. Both releasable catches and anchored continuous cable paths constrain the operation; a temporary parking cradle frees the occupied destination.
